items.title: IKEA invests 1.2 billion euros in price cuts across Europe
items.summary: The Swedish home furnishings retailer IKEA has announced that it is investing 1.2 billion euros in price cuts across Europe. Depending on the country and product category, prices will fall by an average of 15 per cent to 25 per cent.

items.title: Why luxury platform Mytheresa is increasing its focus on personal shoppers
items.summary: E-commerce company Mytheresa wants to place greater emphasis on human interaction and is therefore hiring more personal shoppers. Technology can never replace emotions and relationships, says CEO Francis Belin.

items.title: Zero-sugar labels take center stage in more food class action lawsuits

items.title: Heat wave drives Spa water sales to record levels
items.summary: Spadel, the producer of Spa and Bru, sold significantly more water in the first half of 2026. Warm weather, strong local brands, and new products drove revenue up 10.1%, while operating profit increased by more than a fifth.

items.title: US meat giant OSI strikes deal for Australia’s Cordina Group
items.summary: US-based meat company OSI Group has struck a deal to merge its Australian operations with local poultry business Cordina Group. The post US meat giant OSI strikes deal for Australia’s Cordina Group appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Amazon in court: did the platform make advertisers pay too much?
items.summary: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) and as many as 21 U.S. states are suing Amazon for overcharging advertisers. Since 2019, the e-commerce giant is alleged to have overcharged advertisers by more than $20 billion through its advertising platform.
